note: Wyoming Game & Fish wildlife habitat management area (an elk feedground) about 5 mi N of Pinedale on Willow Lake Rd (CR 119). Camping at the marked campground areas around the lake; motor vehicles only on roads marked with white arrows; no fireworks, no firewood cutting, certified weed-free hay required. --Claude
summary: WGFD page + GeoPDF: agency-designated camping areas (about a dozen campground symbols) around Soda Lake, comfort stations and boat ramps, 14-day limit, area closed to people Dec 1 - May 1 (stored closes 12-01 -> 11-30). Stored count 20 unsourced -> cleared. Lakefront kept on imagery (north-peninsula camping loop ~25-45 m from the high-water line over bare open ground).
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakefront' kept (no numbered sites exist): Soda Lake draws down (terraced bare banks). On a zoom-18 Esri tile the camping loop at the tip of the north peninsula - a fifth-wheel parked at about 42.96304,-109.84529 and vehicles at 42.96261,-109.84619 - sits ~25-45 m from the high-water edge (where the sage ends) across bare open ground, ~70 m from the water at image time. The WGFD map also marks campground symbols at the shore on the east and north arms. Sites are not numbered, so no site list can be given; the call rests on the marked camping areas.
